settings.title: From signup to
settings.intro: No data migration marathon, no six-week onboarding. Northbeam gets your team productive in a single afternoon.

steps.title: Import your data
steps.text: Bring in contacts, deals, and history from a spreadsheet, another CRM, or your inbox. Our importer cleans and dedupes as it goes.

steps.title: Map your pipeline
steps.text: Set up stages that match how you actually sell. Drag, drop, and rename — no code, no IT ticket required.

steps.title: Connect your tools
steps.text: Sync email, calendar, and calls in a few clicks. Every conversation lands in the timeline automatically.

steps.title: Sell with context
steps.text: Your team opens Northbeam and sees exactly who to call next, what they said last, and what's due. No more digging through inboxes.

settings.note: Most teams are running their first tracked deal within 90 minutes of signing up.

settings.title: The CRM your team
settings.intro: A CRM only works if people use it. Northbeam is designed to be fast, obvious, and genuinely helpful — so adoption isn't a battle.

features.title: Effortless data entry
features.text: Log calls, emails, and notes in seconds with keyboard-first shortcuts and smart autofill. If it takes more than a tap, we've failed.

features.title: Pipelines that flex
features.text: Multiple pipelines, custom stages, and deal fields that match your process — not a rigid template you have to bend around.

features.title: Native email & calendar
features.text: Two-way sync with Gmail and Outlook. Emails, meetings, and calls land in the timeline automatically, so nothing slips through.

features.title: Smart follow-up nudges
features.text: Northbeam tells you which deals are going quiet and who's overdue. Your best next action is always one click away.

features.title: Reports that make sense
features.text: Pipeline health, win rates, and rep activity in clean dashboards. Export to your finance team without a data scientist.

features.title: Security you can trust
features.text: SOC 2 Type II, SSO, granular permissions, and full audit logs. Your customer data stays yours, always.

settings.title: Questions teams
settings.intro: Straight answers about migration, pricing, and what moving to Northbeam actually takes.

items.question: How long does it take to migrate from our current CRM?
items.answer: Most teams import their data and are fully set up within a day. Our importer handles contacts, deals, and history from spreadsheets or other CRMs, and cleans up duplicates as it goes.

items.question: Is there a limit on contacts or pipelines?
items.answer: No. Every plan includes unlimited contacts and unlimited pipelines. We believe you shouldn't be punished for growing your business.

items.question: Does Northbeam sync with Gmail and Outlook?
items.answer: Yes. Two-way email and calendar sync is built into every plan. Emails, meetings, and calls land in the deal timeline automatically, so nothing slips through the cracks.

items.question: How is my customer data protected?
items.answer: Northbeam is SOC 2 Type II certified with SSO, granular permissions, and full audit logs on higher plans. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and it's always yours.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Absolutely. Plans are month-to-month with no long-term contract. If Northbeam isn't the right fit, export your data in one click and cancel — no retention calls, no guilt trips.
